backstory:
Dennis Stu is the man who trained Giuseppi on how to be a grifter and pickpocket.


Dennis Stu was always a rapscallion, but never an evil person. He committed petty crimes to survive and thus decided it would be a good idea to join a criminal organization.  He was just a boy at the time, so he didn’t realize the gravity of this situation and how joining a family was an all in scenario. Nor did he realize the level of crimes he used to commit was baby tier compared to the level of crimes he would need to commit for the family. Murder, arson, kidnapping, and so many more crimes. Dennis was a broken man, broken down by the organization and convinced that he was worthless. But that all changed after something in Dennis snapped after 40 years in the family.


Dennis used to be a member of the Jemand family, on their beck and call for 40 years of his life. He was forever a grunt with no hope of moving up in the organization and no hope of leaving. After 40 years of being a slave, he finally decided to bite the bullet and leave. His plan was to get kicked in the head by a donkey and convince everyone he was brain damaged. It worked, he was kicked out in the streets by the family and everyone treated him like a cripple. But, he had his freedom and he didn’t need to commit any more atrocities. He was finally free.


Luckily, Dennis had a good reputation in the small community he grew up in, because he spent a lot of his free time helping people out, feeding the homeless animals, and keeping kids out of trouble. If this was not the case, he’d have died in the streets years ago.
